study_scope: 2023 Netherlands source-weather/market modelled H2 dispatch; prospective 2026+ external H2 supply concept; NOT actual 2023 availability

source_references.title: General Terms and Conditions Transport Annex 7 Pressure Specification
source_references.finding: Temporary network operational 30-50 bar(g), possible future 46.2-66.2 bar(g); wording requires pressure sufficient to ENTER the network; NOT a customer exit pressure guarantee

source_references.title: General Terms and Conditions Transport Annex 2 Quality and Temperature Specifications
source_references.finding: Gas at connection must meet competent-authority specification as amended; this annex does not itself guarantee end-use-grade delivery purity

source_references.title: Contracts and connection process
source_references.locator: Connection Study Agreement and Investment Agreement sections
source_references.finding: EOI/NDA followed by CSA study and then IA/connection process are not evidence that a hypothetical site is connected

source_references.title: Inauguration of first national hydrogen network section, Rotterdam
source_references.finding: 32-km first section completed in Rotterdam in 2026; no evidence of specific PyNEXUS site connection or 2023 supply

source_references.title: DOC 15/21 Gaseous Hydrogen Installations
source_references.locator: Section 10 Storage installations at consumer sites; 10.1 Flow description; Sections 5, 11 and 14
source_references.finding: Pressure reducing station, isolation, relief, check, vent/purge, instrumentation, safety and testing expected for physical hydrogen consumer installation; not project certification

source_references.title: Hydrogen Tube Trailers
source_references.finding: Approx 380 kg steel, composite 560-900 kg cited; US reference not a Dutch vendor certified available payload, does not account for delivery pressure/heel

source_references.title: ISO 14687:2025 Hydrogen fuel quality — Product specification
source_references.finding: Application-specific product quality must be selected; no generic purity automatically guarantees acceptance for undefined H2 end use

source_references.title: Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU
source_references.locator: Scope of stationary pressure equipment over 0.5 bar and conformity assessment
source_references.finding: Pressure equipment requires appropriate conformity assessment, does not itself verify design

source_references.title: B31.12-2023 Hydrogen Piping and Pipelines
source_references.locator: Scope of hydrogen piping and pipelines
source_references.finding: Hydrogen piping engineering reference; local Dutch/EU conformity obligations must still be evaluated
